SELECT HR.EMPID, HR.LOCAL_NAME AS EMP_NAME, HDN.CONTENT AS DEPT_NAME, SY.CONTENT CPNYNAME, LI.IP, TO_CHAR(LI.LOGIN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LOGIN_DATE FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HR, HR_DEPARTMENT HD, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HDN, SY_LOGIN_INFO LI, HR_COMPANY HC, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY WHERE HR.DEPTNO = HD.DEPTNO AND HD.DEPTNO = HDN.DEPTNO(+) AND HDN.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND HR.PERSON_ID = LI.PERSON_ID AND HR.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# AND HR.CPNY_ID = HC.CPNY_ID(+) AND HC.CPNY_NO = SY.NO(+) AND SY.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR#
(HR.LOCAL_NAME like '%'||#EMP_INFO:VARCHAR#||'%' OR HR.EMPID LIKE '%'||#EMP_INFO:VARCHAR#||'%')
TO_CHAR(LI.LOGIN_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') >= #FROM_DATE:VARCHAR#
TO_CHAR(LI.LOGIN_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') <= #TO_DATE:VARCHAR#
ORDER BY $sortname$ $sortorder$
ORDER BY LI.LOGIN_DATE DESC,HR.EMPID

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SY_LOGIN_INFO LI, HR_EMPLOYEE HR WHERE HR.PERSON_ID = LI.PERSON_ID AND HR.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
(HR.LOCAL_NAME like '%'||#EMP_INFO#||'%' OR HR.EMPID LIKE '%'||#EMP_INFO#||'%')
TO_CHAR(LI.LOGIN_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') >= #FROM_DATE:VARCHAR#
TO_CHAR(LI.LOGIN_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') <= #TO_DATE:VARCHAR#
